name: Meta Cheyenne

timeline.event: Structure for Building 1 and 2 under construction.
Building 1 shell and cooling looks complete, Building 2 roof almost complete.
Both buildings estimated to be operational.
Buildings 3 and 4 are similar in style and size to the ones seen at the Prometheus site, we estimate their operability based on that timeline.

sources.publisher: Epoch AI, Frontier Data Centers Hub (CC-BY)
sources.quote: Meta Cheyenne: current power 152 MW; owner Meta.

explain: Meta Cheyenne is an operating AI data center in Cheyenne, WY, owned by meta. Epoch AI estimates it draws 152 MW today and 249 MW when finished.
